entry.content_cn:
本人不日前丢失一条<style="highlight">兽牙项链</style>，项链上串着一枚珍贵的炎晶石，不幸遭坏人所窃！！
善心的寻回者，我可以为<male>他</male><female>她</female><style="highlight">免费占卜</style>一次，保证<style="highlight">占卜百分百准确</style>！！
我会在<style="highlight">咸水镇的水池旁</style>等候。记住！免费占卜的机会！先到先得！

310851.content:

If you're a good Samaritan, I'll perform a <style="highlight">free divination</style> for you, guaranteed to be <style="highlight">one hundred percent accurate</style>!

I'll be waiting by the <style="highlight">water in Alkali </style>. Remember, it's a free divination! First come, first serve!
